Grasp height is 0.9473 m, calculated from the supplied 0.114 m vial height. Place the vial bottom on the worktop at z=0.896 m and retreat vertically by 0.12 m. The supplied initial TCP is already inside the 0.32 m minimum horizontal radius (0.307 m); the first move exits this region, and all commanded targets satisfy the usable-radius limits.

safety_checks: All commanded TCP targets are within the 0.32–0.75 m usable-radius bounds; the initial supplied pose requires the disclosed departure exception.
Keep tool_down=true and yaw constant throughout; no pouring or intentional vial tilt.
Use a conservative 20 mm vial diameter for clearance checks despite the smaller supplied AABB width.
Maintain at least 0.03 m clearance from unrelated AABBs; intended vial grasp and bench support are contact exceptions.
At pickup, a conservative 20 mm vial envelope remains 0.052 m in front of the XRD AABB.
At placement, the conservative vial envelope remains 0.11 m in front of the balance AABB.
Interpolate translation in increments no greater than 0.020 m and enforce orientation deviation no greater than 0.25 rad.
Before execution, validate full-arm IK, gripper envelope, and swept-volume collisions; TCP and object checks alone do not certify robot-link clearance.
